name: 2.8.3 Public Beta
body:
> 🌐 [English](#english) | [中文](#中文) ## English Bambu Studio **V2.8.3 Beta** introduces a series of new features and user experience improvements. This version adds illustrated slicing parameter tips to help users better understand how different settings affect printing. It also improves the interaction experience and filament entry workflow in the Filament Manager, and optimizes the automatic placement behavior of the wipe tower to reduce overlaps and interference with models or other objects. On the slicing side, the slicing engine now supports independently setting the infill line width for the first layer to improve first-layer adhesion. A new Archimedean spiral ironing pattern has been added to further improve top surface quality. In addition, users can now set a separate infill pattern for the second-to-top surface, helping reduce the visibility of internal extrusion marks on the top surface. This release also improves the stability of the Boolean tool, refines mouse interaction behavior, and fixes a range of known issues to provide a smoother overall experience. You can download the Flathub version for Linux from [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio) The Flathub version is maintained by @hadess ; thanks to him for his outstanding work. >Note: 3MF files saved in the Beta version are temporarily not supported for upload to MakerWorld. If you need to upload, please use the official release version. ### New Features #### Illustrated Slicing Parameter Tips When users hover the mouse over a process parameter name, Bambu Studio will display the corresponding parameter tip. Parameter tips now support illustrated explanations, making it easier to understand what each setting means, how it works, and how it may affect the print result. This helps new users learn and adjust slicing parameters more easily.
>Note: This update mainly covers process parameters in Simple Mode. Tips for more advanced parameters will be added and improved in future releases. #### Independently Set Initial-layer Wall and Infill Line Widths This version adds a new **Initial Layer Infill** **Line Width** parameter. The original **Initial** **Layer Line Width** parameter now applies to lines except the infill lines on the initial layer, including the initial-layer wall lines, allowing users to control the wall line width and infill line width of the initial layer separately. Users can moderately increase the initial-layer infill line width based on actual print results. For example, when using a 0.4 mm nozzle, setting the initial-layer infill line width to 0.55 mm can help improve initial-layer adhesion and reduce the chance of poor initial-layer printing.
>Note: It is not recommended to set the initial-layer wall line width too large, as this may increase the risk of losing fine details on the initial layer for certain models. #### Add Filament Vendors / Brands from the Filament Manager Entry Page This version improves the filament entry workflow in the Filament Manager. Users can now add custom filament vendors or brands directly from the entry page.
When the corresponding filament parameter preset does not exist, users can create a custom filament directly in the Filament Manager without switching to the Prepare page, making the workflow more convenient and efficient.
#### New Archimedean Spiral Pattern for Ironing, Providing a More Uniform Surface Finish This version adds a new Archimedean spiral pattern for ironing. The new pattern expands outward gradually from the center of the region, and the toolpath can be naturally interrupted by internal holes in the model. Compared with the standard concentric pattern, it helps reduce marks caused by the innermost toolpaths and produces a more uniform ironing result. [ArchimedeanSpiraliron.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31957265/ArchimedeanSpiraliron.zip)
>Note: Ironing quality is affected by multiple factors, including flow rate, line spacing, top surface print speed, temperature, and the physical properties of the material. Users should tune the settings based on actual print results. The default parameters may not be suitable for all scenarios. ([Wiki](https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/software/bambu-studio/parameter/ironing)) #### New Infill Pattern Parameter for the Sub-Top Surface This version separates the sub-top surface from internal solid infill, allowing users to set its infill pattern independently.
By default, the sub-top surface now uses monotonic infill instead of the rectilinear pattern previously used for internal solid infill. This helps reduce the visibility of extrusion marks from internal solid infill on the model’s top surface and improves the top surface appearance. [sub_top_test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31957279/sub_top_test.zip)
### Improvements #### Improved Mouse Interaction in the 3D Workspace This version improves mouse interaction in the 3D workspace, making zooming, rotating, and panning feel more natural and stable. The improvements include: 1. Mouse wheel zoom now centers on the mouse pointer by default, reducing cases where the model shifts away from the center of the view or even moves out of view during zooming. 2. When rotating the view, Bambu Studio now rotates around the currently selected model by default. If multiple models are selected, it rotates around the center of the selection. If no model is selected, it rotates around the center of the build plate. 3. Canvas dragging, touch rotation, and the 3D Navigator now use the same rotation center, so models are less likely to drift out of view during fast rotation. Users can adjust these interaction behaviors in Preferences according to their personal habits.
#### Improved Wipe Tower Placement Experience This version optimizes the generation and placement behavior of the wipe tower when switching printer models or using auto-arrange, reducing the need for repeated manual adjustments caused by wipe tower position shifts or interference. This improvement mainly addresses the following scenarios: 1. Reduces cases where a creator’s local 3MF file slices correctly, but fails to slice after being uploaded to MakerWorld due to an abnormal wipe tower position. 2. Reduces cases where, after switching printer models, changes in build plate size cause the wipe tower to interfere with the model or unprintable areas, preventing slicing or printing. 3. When switching printer models, Bambu Studio will first try to move the wipe tower to the recommended position for the selected printer model. This behavior is controlled by the **“Automatically optimize wipe tower placement”** option in Preferences and is enabled by default.
The detailed logic includes: 1. When switching printer models, if the model and wipe tower together remain within the build plate area, Bambu Studio will center them as a whole. If the build plate size remains unchanged after switching, centering will not be triggered. The software will then try to place the wipe tower at the recommended position for the selected printer model, while automatically avoiding unprintable areas. If the adjustment fails, the original layout will be preserved. 2. When the wipe tower is generated for the first time, it will be placed at the recommended position for the selected printer model whenever possible, while avoiding unprintable areas. 3. After auto-arrange is completed, the wipe tower will try to move to the recommended position for the selected printer model. If the move fails, it will remain at its original position. #### Filament Manager Entry Workflow Aligned with Bambu Handy This version improves the filament entry workflow in the Filament Manager by aligning the entry fields and operation flow with Bambu Handy, providing a more consistent experience across desktop and mobile devices. Details include: - When a new filament is detected, the corresponding filament in the AMS slot on the Device page will display an entry indicator. Users can click it to confirm and add the filament recognized by the AMS to the Filament Manager.
- When the AMS detects a new filament and multiple filaments of the same type already exist in the Filament Manager, users can choose to bind the detected filament to one of the existing entries, or register it separately as a new filament spool.
#### Improved Filament Selection for AMS / External Spool on the Device Page This version improves the filament selection experience for AMS and external spool holders on the Device page. - During filament selection, filaments are now grouped into two main categories: **Filament Manager** and **System Filaments**. Search and vendor-based filtering are also supported, making it easier for users to find the desired filament. - The page layout and interaction details have been optimized to provide a smoother overall experience.
#### Added Warning for Reversed Faces Previously, Bambu Studio did not support detecting reversed faces in models, which could lead to rendering issues and potentially mislead users. This version adds the ability to detect reversed faces. When users select a model that may contain reversed-face issues, Bambu Studio will display a warning indicating that the model may have rendering abnormalities and recommend repairing it.
#### Other Improvements 1. Adjusted the travel speed for P2S to 1000 mm/s to reduce print time. 2. Improved the color display of gradient filaments and dual-color filaments on the Project Filament page, Filament Manager page, and Gizmo tool interface, making filament color information more accurate and intuitive. 3. Color decompose interface optimization: When selecting Project Filaments as the color decompose method, color decompose is performed after filtering by filament category; when selecting a Standard Palette, different sets only support specific filament types. The interface also more intuitively displays the color decompose results and the filaments that need to be added. 4. Added support for Thai, Indonesian, and Vietnamese. 5. Add "Lock horizon" option for 3Dconnexion devices ([PR 11928](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11928)). Thanks to @timkarnold. ### Bug Fixes 1. Performed low-level optimizations for the mesh Boolean tool, fixing some crashes and incorrect model results, and improving overall tool stability. 2. Fixed an issue on macOS where switching the software language would always cause a crash. ([#11846](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11840)) 3. Fixed an issue where the preset comparison window did not support multiple flow types, causing high-flow filament presets to be displayed with standard-flow parameters during comparison. ([#11311](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11311)) 4. Fixed an issue where STEP, STP, and other model files could not be displayed or imported from macOS Smart Folders. ([#11840](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11840)) 5. Fixed an issue in Dynamic Flow Calibration where the filament slot corresponding to the right nozzle could not be selected, preventing calibration from proceeding. ([#9121](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/9121)) 6. Fixed an issue where, when slicing an object assigned to another filament, the nozzle temperature still used the parameters of the first filament. ([#12010](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12010)) 7. Fixed an issue where opening certain 3MF files exported from third-party software would trigger an error dialog. These messages are now shown as lightweight notifications instead. ([#11995](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11995)) 8. Fixed a potential crash when placing an SVG onto a model surface ([PR 11361](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11361)). Thanks to @amhunt. 9. Fixed an issue where the startup image appeared black on Linux ([PR 11533](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11533)). Thanks to @BenJule. 10. Fixed crashes caused by certain special 3MF files ([PR 12058](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12058), [PR 12001](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12001)). Thanks to @ocidburn and @Kazama-Suichiku. 11. Fixed an issue where Bambu Studio could not start on Linux when using Chinese or Japanese ([PR 12082](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12082)). Thanks to @aoblue2547. 12. Fixed an issue with the filament change G-code in the X2D 0.4 mm nozzle printer preset ([PR 11876](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11876)). Thanks to @dzuelke. 13. Fixed an out-of-bounds issue when the CLI reads multiple extruders ([PR 10912](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10912)). Thanks to @sgbaird. 14. Fixed an issue with incorrect capitalization of the DBus name ([PR 11833](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11833)). Thanks to [hadess](https://github.com/hadess). 15. Fixed a null pointer exception during travel generation ([PR 11644](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11644)). Thanks to @BenJule. 16. Fixed an issue where the software did not work properly on aarch64 with cURL 8.x ([PR 11804](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11804)). Thanks to @hadess. --- ## 中文 Bambu Studio **V2.8.3 Beta** 带来了一系列新功能与体验优化。 本版本新增了图文并茂的切片参数 Tips，帮助用户更直观地理解参数作用；优化了耗材管理器的交互体验与耗材录入流程；改进了擦料塔的自动摆放逻辑，减少与模型或其他对象发生重叠、干涉的情况。 在切片能力方面，切片引擎现在支持单独设置首层填充线宽，以提升首层附着效果；新增阿基米德螺旋线熨烫图案，进一步改善顶部表面质量；同时支持独立设置次顶面的填充图案，有助于减少内部挤压纹在顶面的透出。 此外，本版本还提升了布尔工具的稳定性，优化了鼠标操作相关的交互行为，并修复了一系列已知问题，进一步提升整体使用体验。 ### 新功能 #### 切片参数 Tips 支持图文说明 当用户将鼠标悬停在工艺参数名称上时，Bambu Studio 会显示对应的参数 Tips。现在，参数 Tips 支持图文并茂的展示方式，可以更直观地解释参数含义、作用及其对打印结果的影响，帮助新用户更轻松地理解和调整切片参数。
>注意：本次更新主要覆盖简单模式下的工艺参数。更多高级参数的 Tips 将在后续版本中持续补充和完善。 #### 支持单独设置首层墙与填充的线宽 本版本新增了“首层填充线宽”参数。原有的“首层线宽”参数现在作用于除了首层填充走线之外的其他走线，包括首层墙。用户可以分别控制首层墙线宽与首层填充线宽。 用户可根据实际打印效果，适当调大首层填充线宽。例如，使用 0.4 mm 喷嘴时，可将首层填充线宽设置为 0.55 mm，以改善首层附着效果，降低首层打印不佳的概率。
>注意：不建议将首层墙线宽设置得过大，否则可能增加部分模型首层细节丢失的风险。 #### 耗材管理器录入界面支持新增耗材供应商 / 品牌 本版本优化了耗材管理器的耗材录入流程，支持在录入界面直接添加自定义耗材供应商或品牌。
当对应的耗材参数预设不存在时，用户可以直接在耗材管理器中创建自定义耗材，无需再跳转到准备页面进行创建，操作流程更加便捷高效。
#### 熨烫类型新增阿基米德螺旋线图案，表面效果更均匀 本版本为熨烫功能新增了阿基米德螺旋线图案。新的熨烫图案会以区域中心为起点逐步向外扩展，走线可被模型内部孔洞自然截断。相比普通同心图案，该方式可以减少最内圈走线产生的纹路，使熨烫效果更加均匀。 [ArchimedeanSpiraliron.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31957217/ArchimedeanSpiraliron.zip)
>注意：熨烫效果会受到流量、线距、顶面打印速度、温度、材料物理特性等多种因素影响。用户需要根据实际打印效果进行调校，默认参数并不保证适用于所有场景。 ([Wiki](https://wiki.bambulab.com/zh/software/bambu-studio/parameter/ironing)) #### 新增次顶面填充图案参数 本版本将次顶面从内部实心填充中单独拆分出来，支持为次顶面独立设置填充图案。
默认情况下，次顶面将使用单调填充，替代原先内部实心填充所使用的直线图案。该调整有助于减少内部实心填充挤压纹在模型顶面透出的情况，提升顶面外观质量。 [sub_top_test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31957236/sub_top_test.zip)
### 改进 #### 优化 3D 空间中的鼠标交互行为 本版本优化了 3D 空间中的鼠标交互体验，使视图缩放、旋转与拖拽操作更加自然、稳定。具体包括： 1. 鼠标滚轮缩放默认以鼠标指针所在位置为中心，减少缩放过程中模型偏离画面中心、甚至被“甩出”视野的情况。 2. 旋转视角时，默认围绕当前选中的模型旋转；多选模型时，围绕所选模型的整体中心旋转；未选中任何模型时，则围绕打印盘中心旋转。 3. 画布拖拽、触控旋转与 3D 导航器现在统一使用同一旋转中心，快速旋转时模型不再容易漂出视野。 用户可在偏好设置中根据个人习惯调整相关交互行为。
#### 擦料塔摆放体验优化 本版本优化了切换机型与自动摆盘时的擦料塔生成和摆放行为，减少因擦料塔位置偏移或干涉导致用户需要反复手动调整的情况。 该优化主要改善以下场景： 1. 减少创作者本地 3MF 文件切片正常，但上传至 MakerWorld 后因擦料塔位置异常导致切片失败的情况。 2. 减少用户切换机型后，由于热床尺寸变化导致擦料塔与模型或不可摆放区域发生干涉，从而无法切片或打印的情况。 3. 切换机型时，软件会优先尝试将擦料塔移动至当前机型的推荐位置。该行为由偏好设置中的“自动优化料塔位置”选项控制，并默认开启。
具体逻辑包括： 1. 切换机型时，如果模型与擦料塔整体未超出热床范围，Bambu Studio 会将模型与擦料塔整体居中（若切换前后热床尺寸不变，则不会触发居中），并尝试将擦料塔放置在当前机型的推荐位置，同时自动避让不可摆放区域。若调整失败，则保持原有布局不变。 2. 擦料塔首次生成时，会优先放置在当前机型的推荐位置，并自动避让不可摆放区域。 3. 自动摆盘完成后，擦料塔会尝试移动至当前机型的推荐位置；若移动失败，则保持原位置不变。 #### 耗材管理器录入流程与 Bambu Handy 对齐 本版本优化了耗材管理器的耗材录入功能，使录入字段与操作流程和 Bambu Handy 保持一致，统一桌面端与移动端的使用体验。具体包括： - 新耗材录入时，设备页 AMS 槽位中的耗材会显示录入标识。用户可直接点击确认，将 AMS 识别到的耗材录入耗材管理器。
- 当 AMS 识别到新耗材，且耗材管理器中已存在多个相同类型的耗材时，用户可以选择将该耗材绑定到其中一个已有耗材，也可以将其作为一卷新耗材单独录入。
#### 设备页 AMS / 外挂料架耗材选择体验优化 本版本优化了设备页中 AMS 与外挂料架的耗材选择体验。 - 耗材选择时，耗材将分为“耗材管理器”和“系统配置耗材”两大类，并支持搜索以及按耗材厂商分类，帮助用户更快速地筛选和定位目标耗材。 - 优化了页面展示与交互细节，提升整体操作体验。
#### 新增反向面片提示 此前，Bambu Studio 不支持检测模型中的反向面片问题，可能导致模型渲染异常，并对用户造成误导。 本版本新增了反向面片检测能力。当用户选中存在潜在反向面片问题的模型时，软件会提示该模型可能出现渲染异常，并建议用户进行修复。
#### 其他改进 1. 将 P2S 的空驶速度调整为 1000 mm/s，以缩短打印时间。 2. 优化了项目耗材页面、耗材管理器页面以及 Gizmo 工具界面中渐变耗材、双拼耗材的颜色显示效果，使耗材颜色信息展示更加准确、直观。 3. 拆色功能界面优化：拆色方式选择「项目耗材」时，按照耗材大类进行过滤后拆色；选择「标准套装」时，不同套装只支持特定的耗材类型，同时更加直观的展示拆色后的结果与需要新增的耗材。 4. 新增对泰语、印尼语和越南语的支持。 5. 为 3Dconnexion 设备添加“锁定水平线”选项 ([PR 11928](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11928))。感谢 @timkarnold ### Bug修复 1. 对网格布尔工具进行了底层优化，修复了部分崩溃及模型结果不正确的问题，提升工具稳定性 2. 修复了 macOS 上切换软件语言时必然崩溃的问题([#11846](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11846)) 3. 修复预设对比窗口不支持多种流量类型，导致对比高流量耗材预设时显示为标准流量参数的问题([#11311](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11311)) 4. 修复 macOS 智能文件夹中无法显示和导入 STEP、STP 等模型文件的问题([#11840](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11840)) 5. 修复动态流量校准中无法选择右喷嘴对应耗材槽位，导致校准无法进行的问题([#9121](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/9121)) 6. 修复为对象指定其他耗材进行切片时，喷嘴温度仍取用第一个耗材参数的问题([#12010](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12010)) 7. 修复打开部分第三方软件导出的 3MF 文件时弹出错误提示窗口的问题。现在，该类提示将以轻量提示方式展示([#11995](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11995)) 8. 修复 SVG 贴到模型表面时可能崩溃的问题 ([PR 11361](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11361))。 感谢@amhunt 9. 修复linux上启动图片是黑色的问题([PR 11533](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11533))。感谢@BenJule 10. 修复特殊3mf导致crash的问题([PR 12058](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12058)，[PR 12001](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12001))。感谢@ocidburn和@Kazama-Suichiku 11. 修复 Linux使用中文和日文无法启动的问题([PR 12082](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12082))。感谢@aoblue2547 12. 修复X2D 0.4喷嘴机器预设中换料gcode的异常([PR 11876](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11876))。感谢@dzuelke 13. 修复CLI读取多挤出机的越界问题([PR 10912](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10912))。感谢@sgbaird 14. 修复 DBus 名称大小写错误的问题（[PR 11833](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11833))。感谢@hadess 15. 修复空驶路径生成过程中可能导致软件异常退出的问题。([PR 11644](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11644))。感谢@BenJule 16. 修复在 aarch64 平台、使用 cURL 8.x 时软件无法正常工作的问题([PR 11804](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11804))。感谢@hadess

name: 2.8.2.61 Public Release
body:
Bambu Studio 2.8.2.61 is a minor optimization update based on the previous version. It fixes several known issues and improves the experience of certain features.

You can download the Flathub version for Linux from [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio)
The Flathub version is maintained by @hadess , thanks to him for his outstanding work.

## Bug Fixes
1.  Fixed an issue where some MakerLab generators were inaccessible. (Note: Relief Maker downloads may experience import delays; a fix will be deployed via a subsequent MakerLab backend update.)
2. Fixed an issue where the login window did not appear when accessing MakerWorld while not signed in.
3. Fixed an issue where, after clicking “Sync Printer Information” in older 3MF files, the number of extruders could still be displayed as 0, which could further lead to slicing errors.
4. When adding or removing filaments from the filament list on the left side of the Prepare page, the list will now automatically scroll to the bottom. This helps prevent users from mistakenly thinking the operation did not take effect when the filament list is long.
5. Fixed an occasional crash in LAN mode under unstable network conditions.
6. Updated presets for X2D and H-series printers, fixing several abnormal parameter values to prevent issues when loading or using the presets.

name: 2.8.2 Public Release
body:
## Known Issue: 1. The macOS 27 Beta network plugin can now be downloaded normally and supports cloud connections. However, users may be unable to connect to printers over LAN. This is because the current configuration may trigger a permission issue on macOS 27 Beta. We are working on this issue and will fix it in a future release, when the final release of macOS 27 is public. 2. On macOS 27 Beta ,after switching filament mapping in the send-to-print dialog, a white floating window may occasionally appear. Re-selecting the same filament slot resolves the issue. 3. On macOS 27 Beta,Bambu Studio cannot exit full screen after the window is maximized. You can use the shortcut **Command (⌘) + Control (^) + F** to exit full screen as a workaround. This Bambu Studio update brings several major new features and experience improvements, including pause point information on the print progress bar, model assembly guide creation, upgraded color prediction and color decompose capabilities, enhanced filament management on the Device page, E3D hotend support, and multiple improvements to slicing and device interaction. You can download the Flathub version for Linux from [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio). The Flathub version is maintained by @hadess ; thanks to him for his outstanding work. ## New Features ### Pause Point Information on the Print Progress Bar Users can now view pause point information directly on the print progress bar, including the total number of pause points in the current print job, how many pause points have already been triggered, and the locations of upcoming pause points. When hovering the mouse over a pause point marker on the progress bar, users can also see the estimated time until the pause is triggered. This helps users prepare in advance for operations such as inserting parts, changing colors, or placing magnets. Notes: 1. This feature requires printer firmware support. The minimum supported firmware version is 01.02.50.00（H2S）. Support for additional printers will be rolled out gradually through firmware updates. 2. The print progress bar can display up to 5 upcoming pause points. As printing progresses, information for later pause points will be displayed progressively on the progress bar.
## Improvements ### Print a Shorter Prime Tower to Save Filament When Color Changes Only Occur at Higher Layers After enabling Developer Mode, users can enable the “No sparse layers” option under Others > Prime Tower. When enabled, Bambu Studio will skip intermediate layers where no filament change is needed when generating the prime tower. The prime tower will only be generated near the height where filament changes occur, reducing material consumption. For print jobs where color changes only happen at higher layers, this feature can help save filament to a certain extent. Notes: 1. This feature is still experimental. It also has certain requirements for the relative position between the prime tower and the model, and can only work properly when these requirements are met. 2. Because the Z-axis movement is relatively slow, moving from the shorter prime tower back to the model after printing the tower may take a longer time. This may increase the risk of print defects such as oozing or stringing.
### Filament Manager Displays Filament Note Information The Filament Manager can now display Note information in the filament list, making it easier to distinguish between multiple spools of the same filament type. [#11354](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11354) Users can also search for filaments by their Note information in the search window. [PR #11505](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11505). Thanks to @BenJule.
### Improved Floating Issues with Tree Supports For organic tree supports, Bambu Studio now enables lightning infill reinforcement by default for internal cavities, reducing the risk of print failures caused by unsupported or floating support structures. ### Part-level Clone Added to the Right-click Menu Users can now clone individual parts directly from the right-click menu, improving the efficiency of copying and editing multi-part models.
### Improved Print Time Estimation for A2L When Connected to Different AMS Types For A2L printers connected to different types of AMS, Bambu Studio has optimized the print time estimation related to AMS filament changes, making the estimated print time closer to the actual print duration. Users can also calibrate loading and unloading times based on their own PTFE tube length and AMS type. > ⚠️ Minimum supported firmware version: 01.01.01.00（A2L）
### A2L Displays First-layer Thermal Preconditioning Areas and Explains Their Impact on Print Time The Bambu Lab A2L now holds the heatbed at its target temperature before automatic bed leveling, which helps ensure a consistent first layer. The extra wait time depends on where the model is placed on the build plate. This feature is currently supported on the A2L (see below for the minimum firmware version). Bambu Studio now visualizes these Thermal Preconditioning areas so users can adjust model placement accordingly. Note that areas near the edge of the heatbed generally take longer to reach a stable temperature. The area prompts and warnings can be turned off in Preferences. > ⚠️ Minimum supported firmware version: 01.01.01.00（A2L）
## Other Improvements 1. The live camera view on the Device page now supports mouse wheel zooming. [PR #11325](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11325). Thanks to @BenJule. Note: Panning is not currently supported and will be optimized in a future version. 2. Optimized PET-CF material parameters to improve print quality in overhang scenarios. 3. Updated the recommended process parameters for using PVA to support PLA. The support bottom Z distance is now set to 0 to improve support stability. 4. When the cloud service is abnormal or the network is unstable, the software will automatically try switching to LAN mode to continue sending the print, improving device connection stability. 5. Optimized filament mapping logic on the print sending page to reduce mismatches between sliced filaments and the actual filament types loaded in the printer. 6. The Assembly Guide tool now supports Undo and Redo, improving fault tolerance and editing efficiency during assembly guide creation. 7. When using the Cut tool to cut a model and generate dovetail joints, the original painting information of the model will be preserved. 8. When multiple AMS slots contain filaments of the same type and color, the print sending page will prioritize matching the filament with the lower remaining amount. [PR #11347](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11347). Thanks to @ojimpo. 9. Optimized slicing logic for multi-toolhead printers in filament-saving mode. When there is only one filament change, the slicing engine will try to group filaments according to the actual left/right filament arrangement, avoiding the need for users to rearrange filaments on the printer just to save a single filament change. 10. Enhanced the stability and workflow safety of Helio simulation, reducing failures caused by unstable network conditions. [PR #11793](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11793). Thanks to @HelioPri. 11. The “Copy to Clipboard” function in the System Information dialog now includes more complete information, making it easier for users to provide software and system details when reporting issues and improving diagnostic efficiency. [PR #11491](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11491). Thanks to @BenJule. ## Bug Fixes 1. Fixed a crash that could occur when shutting down the application. ([#11482](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11482)) 2. Fixed excessively long slice times on plates with many objects. ([#11255](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11255)) 3. Fixed an issue where the project profile name displayed incorrectly or failed to display. ([#10769](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10769)) 4. Fixed an issue where custom bed textures appeared black after loading. ([#11314](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11314)) 5. Fixed a crash that could occur during automatic flow dynamics calibration in certain cases. ([#11416](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11416)) 6. Fixed incorrect slicing colors bleeding into adjacent objects when importing standard multi-color 3MF files with single-color volumes. ([#11348](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11348)) 7. Fixed tree support roots being generated in mid-air instead of resting on the model or bed. ([#11681](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11681)) 8. Fixed floating tree support regions that had nothing underneath to support them. ([#11681](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11681)) 9. Fixed an intermittent blank screen when opening Filament Manager on Mac. ([#11005](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11005)) 10. Fixed an issue where the Pressure Advance setting always showed Default. ([#8196](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/8196)) 11. Fixed an intermittent crash when saving that could leave the file unsaved. ([#11715](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11715)) 12. Fixed a login loop when using a Google/Gmail account to download models. ([#11095](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11095)) 13. Fixed MakerWorld logo and “open in browser” external links that failed to open. ([#11579](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11579)) 14. Fixed legacy or custom filament profiles being blocked from slicing on high-flow and similar nozzles. ([#11589](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11589)) 15. Fixed grammar and formatting issues in user-facing UI strings. ([PR #11257](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11257)) 16. Fixed an issue where saved PA calibration profiles were not shown in the AMS materials dialog for the main extruder. ([PR #10850](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10850)) 17. Fixed a misspelling in the Dutch translation of travel speed. ([PR #11480](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11480)) 18. Fixed several English UI wording and punctuation issues. ([PR #10814](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10814)) 19. Fixed missing Node.js dependency support that prevented building on Linux ARM64. ([PR #10712](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10712)) 20. Fixed missing device name for SpaceMouse Wireless BT that prevented correct recognition. ([PR #11755](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11755)) 21. Fixed Linux single-instance mode failing to pass files opened in a second instance to the running instance. ([PR #11826](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11826))

name: 2.8.1 Public Beta
body:
Bambu Studio V2.8.1 introduces Decompose Color, E3D nozzle support, and device-page filament management, along with a range of improvements and bug fixes. You can download the Flathub version for Linux from [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio) The Flathub version is maintained by [@hadess](https://github.com/hadess) ; thanks to him for his outstanding work. > Note: 3MF files saved in the Beta version are temporarily not supported for upload to MakerWorld. If you need to upload, please use the official release version. ## Features ### Color Prediction & Decompose Color Updated the color prediction algorithm for the CMYW and RYBW combinations of Bambu PLA Basic, delivering more accurate layered-color results with these two combinations. Also introduced Decompose Color, which automatically breaks a target color down into the optimal filament combination. - Decompose colors from the filament list, or into a specific color combination (currently only the CMYW and RYBW combinations of Bambu PLA Basic are supported).
- Automatic Decompose Color for textured models: after importing a colored model, the software automatically matches your filament library to generate a decomposition scheme, with no manual color setup required.
### Device-Page Filament Management - Bind filaments from the Filament Manager to editable slots.
- View each filament's presence (mount) status and the device it's currently on.
- When loading a Bambu Filament that hasn't been added yet, quickly create a new spool or bind it to an existing filament right from the device page.
### E3D Hotend Integration - Added a new "E3D High Flow" nozzle type, supported on H2D, H2S, H2C (left head only), X2D, and P2S. - Shown in the sidebar only for 0.4 / 0.6 mm nozzle diameters.
### Remaining Filament Reminder Added remaining-filament reminder support for the H2D. > ⚠️ Minimum supported firmware version: 01.03.50.00 (H2D) - Prompts remaining filament status during print-related workflows. - Makes it easier to prepare a filament change in advance, reducing the risk of print interruptions.
## Improvements ### Preferences Page Redesign - Restructured the layout and presentation of the Preferences page. - Makes it easier and faster to find and adjust commonly used options.
### Assembly Guide Improvements - Fixed an issue where splitting or merging objects in the Prepare view affected the tree structure in the Assembly view. - Added support for adding parts to assembly steps from either the list or the canvas. - Added "face-to-face" and "point-to-point" alignment, with Gizmo-based assembly. - Improved large-text rendering for better label readability. ### Filament Track Switch - H2D now supports the Filament Track Switch. > ⚠️ Minimum supported firmware version: 01.03.50.00 (H2D) ### Other Improvements 1. Mixing ratios for layered colors can now be entered manually, improving precision for two or three-color blends. 2. Added a Wiki help link to the A2L Quick Mode interface. 3. Improved flush time estimation for H2D: heating and cooling are now calculated separately, making multi-color flush duration more accurate. 4. Generating a PA calibration tower no longer overrides the wall speed defined in the preset. 5. Updated Ukrainian translation. Thanks to @Tarasovych for the contribution. 6. Restored the --datadir argument, allowing a custom configuration directory (network paths supported). Thanks to @mpaperno for the contribution. 7. Builds can now optionally use the system-provided GMP / MPFR libraries. Thanks to @hadess for the contribution. 8. When the system temp directory is low on space, slicing temporary files are now stored in the data directory instead, reducing export failures for large models (especially on Linux systems with a small /tmp). Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. 9. When a project has unsaved changes, an "*" is now prepended to the window title and automatically removed after saving (all platforms). Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. 10. Added portable operation: when a local configuration folder is detected, it takes priority, making it easier to run multiple versions side by side. Thanks to @mpaperno for the contribution. ## Bug Fixes 1. Fixed first-layer sagging when using a single-layer raft, and fixed the object's first-layer infill incorrectly using the initial-layer speed. ([#10897](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10897)) 2. Fixed a slicing crash after fully color-painting a modifier. ([#11152](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11152)) 3. Fixed an issue where setting the language to Traditional Chinese (zh_TW) was reset to en_GB after restart. ([#11188](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11188) ) 4. Fixed a startup crash caused by interacting with the setting recommendation popup after enabling Alternate extra wall. ([#11236](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11236)) 5. Fixed max_bridge_length not taking effect, which caused supports to still be generated in the sacrificial-layer area of bridged counterbore holes. ([#11317](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11317)) 6. Fixed sorting by filament name not working in the Filament Manager. ( [#11042](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11042) ) 7. Fixed the Filament Manager tab content being incorrectly zoomed in when resizing the window on macOS. ([#11267](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11267)) 8. Fixed spelling errors in UI text such as "paramters" and "overwriten". Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. ([#11248](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11248)) 9. Corrected the custom filament vendor name from "3Dgunius" to "3Dgenius". Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. ([#11250](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11250) ) 10. Fixed multiple spelling errors in UI text. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. ([#11254](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11254)) 11. Fixed incorrect filament selection in multi-nozzle manual calibration. Thanks to @disaster123 for the contribution. ([#11117](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11117)) 12. Fixed a download failure in the Homebrew release workflow when macOS assets were not yet available. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. ([#11291](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11291)) 13. Fixed G-code export failures always reporting "disk full" instead of showing the actual system error. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. ([#11066](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11066)) 14. Fixed file dialogs defaulting to the process working directory instead of a sensible path. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution.([#11256](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11256))

name: 2.8.0 Public Beta
body:
Bambu Studio V2.8.0 adds features such as the Assembly Guide generation tool and counterbore hole bridging, along with a number of improvements and bug fixes. You can download the Flathub version for Linux from [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio). The Flathub version is maintained by @hadess ; thanks to him for his outstanding work. > Note: 3MF files saved in the Beta version are temporarily not supported for upload to MakerWorld. If you need to upload, please use the official release version. ## Features ### Supports designing and generating model assembly guides directly within Studio Step-by-step assembly guide for complex models (new): Import a STEP file to automatically split it into assembly steps, with visual guidance to help you understand how parts fit together. - Edit the objects/parts of each step through the object tree - Two viewing modes — X-ray and "Show current step only" — for easier positioning - Supports exploded-view animation and multiple annotation types (snap-fit / rectangle / text); generate an assembly walkthrough animation in one click, with a unified camera view and auto-layout - One-click export to PDF / Markdown / MP4 For details, see the wiki: https://e.bambulab.com/t?c=T0HuraoU2gH6ufRk
### Added Counterbore Hole Bridging Support A new "Counterbore hole bridging" option under Quality → Advanced. It lets you print counterbore/countersunk holes without supports, with three modes:


- None: Default behavior; no bridging is applied.


- Partially bridged: Bridges only the overhanging ring region while leaving the center open.


- Sacrificial layer: Generates a single full bridged layer over the entire hole as a sacrificial layer, providing a base for the layers above.
Many thanks to @szc188 for the contribution. ## Improvements ### Time-lapse Video Quality Improved Across All Printer Models Optimized the tool head landing point to prevent camera shake caused by uncertain landing positions, and enhanced the viewing experience of time-lapse photography videos. Ensure that the tool head during time-lapse photography is as far away from the camera as possible to avoid any obstruction. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3778587d-03aa-4dd3-9b71-a7d77d8c4bda
Time-lapse video (after optimization)


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/49d2a5b8-926a-40de-a108-b9af56c0d40a
Time-lapse video (before optimization)
## Other Improvements 1. For the H2D, this Beta adds a foreign object detection toggle and enhanced curve-planning support, and improves circular hole compensation. ⚠️ Minimum required firmware version: 01.03.50.00 (H2D) 2. Fixed an issue where dialogs popped up repeatedly in some not-logged-in scenarios. 3. Added a confirmation dialog when clicking to clear "Recent files." 4. Updated the price information for some filament presets. 5. When the flushing-volume matrix automatically calculates flushing volumes, it now accounts for switching between official material types: for example, switching between PLA and PETG automatically increases the flushing volume to prevent insufficient interlayer adhesion. 6. Added support for the 3Dconnexion SpaceMouse Pro Wireless Bluetooth Edition. Thanks to @mpaperno for the contribution. ## Bug Fixes 1. Fixed an issue where the Bridge flow under Quality Settings did not update the G-code bridge line layer height when Top Z distance was set to 0. ([#10127](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10127)) 2. Fixed an issue where settings could not be copied and pasted from one part to another. ([#10996](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10996)) 3. Fixed an issue where G-code files generated by earlier Studio versions lost color painting (multi-color) information. ([#10984](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10984)) 4. Fixed an issue where Studio crashed when opening a file from MakerWorld. ([#11037](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11037)) 5. Fixed an issue where the incremental numbering in "Fill with copies" overflowed and became incorrect after exceeding 99. ([#10492](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10492)) 6. Fixed an issue where modifying a negative part reset the original object's location. ([#10191](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10191)) 7. Fixed an issue where normal support expansion created extra isolated support structures. ([#11110](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11110)) 8. Fixed an issue where the remaining drying time was displayed in an incorrect time format. ([#11171](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11171)) 9. Fixed an issue where the slicing tips for shrinkage-prone filament did not follow the same display logic as other tips. 10. Fixed an issue where, after enabling Alternate Extra Wall, changing the wall loops count and saving the process settings caused Bambu Studio to crash on the next launch (failing to open). ([#11178](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11178)) 11. Fixed an issue where the bridge speed set individually for each part did not take effect. 12. Fixed a use-after-free issue with the WebView async callback on macOS. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution.([#11052](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11052)) 13. Fixed a crash when loading objects with no instances. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. ([#11053](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11053)) 14. Fixed a typo (percision → precision) in the device manager for motion calibration. Thanks to @mvanhorn for the contribution. ([#10871](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10871)) 15. Fixed an issue where the Edit Filament dialog was not centered on its parent window. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. ([#10835](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10835)) 16. Fixed security vulnerabilities in the undici, js-yaml, and @babel/core dependencies. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. ([#10877](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10877)) 17. Fixed a compilation issue caused by undeclared boost::prior. Thanks to @hadess for the contribution. ([#11059](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11059)) 18. Fixed an issue where the AMS slot edit icon click detection missed the Y-bound check, causing inaccurate clicks. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. ([#10859](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10859)) 19. Fixed punctuation and grammar errors in UI warning/tip strings. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. ([#10813](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10813))

name: 2.7.1.62 Public Release
body:
This version is based on the 2.7.1 Public Release and includes optimizations for Studio startup slowdown issues on certain MacOS versions. Affected MacOS users are encouraged to upgrade as soon as possible. This release also includes several other bug fixes. You can download the Flathub version for Linux from [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio) The Flathub version is maintained by @hadess , thanks to him for his outstanding work. ## Bug Fixes 1. Fixed a potential startup slowdown issue on certain MacOS versions. Thanks to @BenJule for the contribution. An option to enable or disable Filament Management has been added in Preferences. On MacOS, this option is disabled by default.
2. Fixed an issue where network plugin installation could fail for some MacOS users (excluding MacOS 27 and later versions). 3. Fixed a path planning error that could occur in certain scenarios when using cross-Z-height coloring in mixed-color printing. 4. Fixed a UI flickering issue with the X2D Filament Track Switch. 5. Fixed an issue with the "Connected Same Color" feature in the Painting Tool. 6. Fixed an issue where the Device page could crash or become unresponsive in certain scenarios. 7. Fixed a crash that occurred when opening certain MakerWorld models. Special thanks to @BenJule once again.

name: 2.7.1 Public Release
body:
V2.7.1 Public Release is a new version based on [2.6.1 Public Beta](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases/tag/v02.06.01.55) and [2.7.0 Public Beta](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases/tag/v02.07.00.55). Compared to V2.6.0 Public Release, this version adds support for the [Bambu Lab A2L](https://bambulab.com/zh), introduces important new features such as Texture-to-Color Painting and the Filament Manager, along with various improvements and bug fixes. You can download the Flathub version for Linux from [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio) The Flathub version is maintained by @hadess ; thanks to him for his outstanding work. ## Known Issue: Startup lag on macOS 26.5 and later Some users running macOS 26.5 or 26.5.1 may experience UI lag and steadily increasing memory usage after launching Bambu Studio. In some cases, this can lead to application crashes. The issue appears to be related to the initialization of the built-in WebView and is currently under investigation. See [#11004](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/11004) / [#10968](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10968) for details. ### Temporary workarounds - Use the [pre-release version](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases/download/v02.07.01.57/Bambu_Studio_mac-v02.07.01.57-pre_release.dmg). - Minimize and then restore/maximize the Bambu Studio window after launch using the window buttons in the top left. - Open any subpage, such as Preferences. - Roll back to [Bambu Studio 2.6.0 Public Release](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases/download/v02.06.00.51/Bambu_Studio_mac-v02.06.00.51-20260417160415.dmg) . We are actively working on a fix and will release it as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience. > ⚠️ Notice for V2.7.0 Public Beta Users: Due to the addition of new machine preset configurations and related placeholders in this release, slicing with V2.7.0 may result in errors in certain scenarios. Please upgrade to V2.7.1 Public Release as soon as possible to avoid these issues. ## Features ### Gradient Color Curve Control for Multi-Color Printing Gradient effects now support more flexible layer height control. A Color Curve Panel has been added for gradient colors, allowing users to freely add anchor points (left-click to add, right-click to remove) and drag the color curve to customize the blending ratio of two colors at different Z heights, enabling richer gradient effects.
### Liveview Full-Screen Support Liveview now supports full-screen display and playback. Thanks to @bdpdx for the contribution, we optimized some frontend interaction features based on his work. > 💡 Tip: Press **ESC** to exit full-screen mode.
### Alternate Extra Wall When enabled, an extra wall is added to alternating layers while other layers retain the original wall count. This option is suitable for improving model structural strength without needing to add extra walls on every layer. Thanks to contributions from @igiannakas and @jomixlaf. > ⚠️ Note: This option is mutually exclusive with Spiral Vase Mode (or 0% infill).
## Improvements ### Texture-to-Color Painting Feature Optimization - Multi-texture model processing optimization: Improved color sampling stability when importing multi-texture models, including fixes to UV mapping for multi-texture atlases, improved base color material processing logic, and optimized color clustering algorithm and smoothing control. - New mesh error detection and repair confirmation workflow: Automatically detects mesh errors when importing textured models, improves the built-in repair capability to ensure model watertightness, and can invoke the Windows mesh repair tool when necessary. - FBX file import support. ### Filament Manager Optimization - Supports multi-selection for batch adding filaments. - Added an overwrite confirmation prompt when the same spool of filament is added again (via RFID recognition). - Other interaction and UI detail optimizations.
### Improved PETG Prime Tower Stability with Filament Track Switch This update improves the prime tower's stability during printing by disabling flat ironing (setting the ironing area to zero) while keeping line ironing, and by adding extra extrusion next to the prime tower. ### LAN Mode Auto-Saves Connection Information LAN connection information can now be saved locally, eliminating the need to re-bind LAN printers after restarting Studio. (#7891, #8270, #8409, #9042) ### Other Improvements 1. Fixed GMP build issue with GCC15. Thanks to contributions from @hadess and @c2h5oh. 2. Added support for building with VS 2026 and CMake 4.2. 3. Updated the display and interaction effects of filament controls in the assembly view. 4. Changed the default Paint Fill mode to Edge Detection mode. ## Bug Fixes 1. To address potential collapse issues caused by chamfers introduced at the bottom of supports in certain scenarios, the bottom 2mm of supports now defaults to 2 walls (this behavior is disabled when 0 or single wall is specified). (#10542, #10775) 2. Added a new "Order-independent overlap carving" option (disabled by default) to prevent the Object List sequence from affecting slice results of embedded models in certain scenarios.
3. Fixed an issue where the collision detection algorithm in sequential printing did not correctly account for skirt spacing. 4. Fixed several errors in sequential printing and some issues during plate size switching. (#8770) 5. Fixed an issue where slicing was interrupted by empty or un-sliceable plates when slicing all plates. (#10296) 6. Fixed abnormal display of model collision risk zones in sequential printing scenarios. (#10434) 7. Fixed an issue where nozzle temperature was displayed incorrectly when importing filament presets in certain scenarios. (#10583) 8. Fixed an issue where PA value requests failed in certain scenarios. (#10351) 9. Fixed an issue where printing could not be initiated after slicing on the A1 mini in certain scenarios. (#10418)

name: 2.7.0 Public Beta
body: You can download the Flathub version for Linux from [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio) The Flathub version is maintained by @hadess ; thanks to him for his outstanding work. > Note: 3MF files saved in the Beta version are temporarily not supported for upload to MakerWorld. If you need to upload, please use the official release version. ## Features ### Texture-to-Color Painting Convert textured models directly into multicolor painting on the model surface. Ideal for applying colored artwork (logos, decorative patterns) to 3D models in multicolor printing. Currently supports OBJ, glTF, and GLB textured model imports. > ⚠️ Notes: > - Single-textured models are recommended for now: conversion quality for multi-texture models will be improved in upcoming versions. > - Loading multiple textured models for conversion at the same time is not yet supported. Please import them one at a time. > - Draco-compressed glTF / GLB is not yet supported: support will be added in a future release. > - For models with significant mesh defects, we recommend repairing them before import. This feature provides limited mesh auto-repair, but cannot guarantee a watertight result. > - Due to a third-party library depended on, import errors may occur in some scenarios on macOS and Linux. We will continue to improve this in upcoming versions. ## Improvements ### Mesh Defect Diagnostics Improvements Refined parts of the mesh defect detection algorithm: - Improved detection accuracy for non-manifold edges. - Open edges are now counted as a separate category. > ℹ️ Note: Non-manifold edges are reported as Error, and open edges are reported as Info. ### Gradient Effect Supported Per-Part Gradient A new "Enable per-part gradient effect" option has been added to the Mixed Filament gradient settings: - On: each part within a combined object receives its own gradient, transitioning smoothly from its own bottom layer to its own top layer. - Off (default): preserves the existing behavior, applying a single gradient across the entire object's Z range. Particularly useful when printing combined objects made up of parts with different heights — each small part can now show a complete, self-contained gradient. ### Painted Color Information Preserved After Plane Cut Painted color information is now preserved after a Plane Cut, so there's no need to repaint the model after cutting. Special thanks to @solidblu for the contribution. (#[10613](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10613)) > ⚠️ Note: Minor alignment differences may appear on painted facets near the cut surface. ## Other Improvements 1. Migrated to WebKitGTK 4.1 for better compatibility with modern Linux distributions. Thanks to @jijinbei for the contribution. 2. 3D view preset shortcuts (Ctrl + [0–7]) now work even when the canvas doesn't have focus. Thanks to @mpaperno for the contribution. 3. Traditional Chinese language entry added: Traditional Chinese option is now available under Preferences → Language, allowing Traditional Chinese users to use Bambu Studio in their preferred language. Thanks to @hezhen0816 for the contribution. > ℹ️ Note: Translations for some languages are still being refined; a small number of UI strings may temporarily appear in English. 4. Added **PLA Pure** filament presets. 5. Filament Manager now displays official filament color information, with support for multi-color and gradient filaments, as well as cloud sync. ## Bug Fixes 1. Fixed a potential crash when modifying infill density in sequential printing mode. (#[10350](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10350)) 2. Fixed an issue where certain threshold angles in support generation were incorrectly clamped. (#[10553](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10553)) 3. Fixed an issue where the K value did not update in time in some scenarios. Thanks to [@maziggy](https://github.com/maziggy) for the contribution. (#[9984](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/9984)) 4. Fixed an issue in Filament Manager where some languages were not displayed correctly; untranslated strings now fall back to English. (#[10428](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10428)) 5. Fixed a potential crash when clicking "View all object settings". Thanks to @hadess for the contribution. (#[10607](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/10607)) 6. Fixed an issue on Linux where the parent dropdown lost focus when a sub-dropdown was opened.(#[10175](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10175)) 7. The high-shrinkage filament warning is now shown as a daily tip instead of every time. 8. Fixed an issue where a customized plate type was ignored when sending a print job. (#[10171](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10171)) 9. Fixed an issue where official Bambu Lab filaments were misidentified as third-party filaments in AMS in certain scenarios. （#[10279](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10279)） 10. Fixed an issue in Flow Rate Calibration where the speed was adjusted instead of the flow rate.（#[10005](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10005)） 11. Fixed a crash when switching to the Device tab on multi-AMS printers.（#[10364](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/10364)）
